\newglossaryentry{pandoc}{name={pandoc},description={A tool that converts documents between formats.}}

\newacronym[description={Power distribution network. The metal grid that carries power to the cells.}]{PDN}{PDN}{power distribution network}
\newacronym[description={Phase-locked loop. A circuit that makes a clock from a reference clock.}]{PLL}{PLL}{phase-locked loop}
